rows.reason: A format choice (baseline sequential, 4:2:0 or grey); it has no distribution.
QOI is lossless: output is exact by construction, with no tolerance.
A cycle count from the signoff clock and a counted simulation on a named image; arithmetic, not a sampled quantity.
Table contents are loaded values; the table paths are exact.
Static timing at each ratified corner is a deterministic analysis of the routed netlist.
Byte-exact against the golden encoder; exact by definition.
DRC and LVS are pass/fail on the layout; STA closure is checked at every ratified corner. None is a sampled quantity.
